item.name: protectedpaths

description.content: A protected path is a data path in the Element Store (file/object system) that is protected by snapshots which may be replicated to an S3 replication peer or to an async replication peer. Scheduling and replication is controlled by an associated protection policy.

item.name: Create a Clone to Restore a Path.

request.name: Create a Clone to Restore a Path.

description.content: This endpoint creates a cloned directory of a path from a selected snapshot of a protected path, for the purpose of restoring the path. To complete the restore process, call the /protectedpaths/{id}/commit operation.
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

item.name: Stops snapshot restore on protected path.

request.name: Stops snapshot restore on protected path.

description.content: This endpoint stops a restore on a protected path. It removes the snapshot clone created by the restore operation. It is available until the restore is committed.

variable.description: (Required) The ID of the protected path
(Required) The ID of the protected path

description.content: Added as a part of security scheme: apikey

item.name: Returns validations results for Protected Path.

request.name: Returns validations results for Protected Path.

description.content: This endpoint returns validation results for a protected path. The results returned can be used to warn users if a protected path has s3_versioning enabled and that restoring the path may lead to losing versions that aren't part of the restored snapshot.
Added as a part of security scheme: apikey
